# Assessment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Assessment`](gmeow-Assessment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Assessment>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An observation that scores a target against a criterion (or whole rubric) — vantage = the judge, human or model: an LLM judge is just a vantage, and two models disagreeing are two coexisting cells with no winner ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). The judge model's identity and prompt digest travel as observation provenance. [`gmeow:assessmentCriterion`](../properties/gmeow-assessmentCriterion.md) / [`gmeow:assessmentRubric`](../properties/gmeow-assessmentRubric.md) play the [`observationMethod`](../properties/gmeow-observationMethod.md) ROLE but are deliberately not subproperties of it ([`observationMethod`](../properties/gmeow-observationMethod.md) is functional with a QualityValue range; [`Criterion`](gmeow-Criterion.md) and [`Rubric`](gmeow-Rubric.md) are Entities — the [`claimModality`](../properties/gmeow-claimModality.md) axiom pattern). Scoring-density expectations by target granularity reuse kernel [`gmeow:hasGranularity`](../properties/gmeow-hasGranularity.md) on the target.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Assessment`](gmeow-Assessment.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a score of a target against a criterion or rubric — an observation whose vantage is the judge, human or model; disagreeing judges are coexisting cells with no winner.

### Avoid when

- Avoid treating a model's score as ground truth (an LLM judge is just a vantage — [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid omitting a zero score; a zero is a score, not an absence (false positives are worse than zeros).

### How to use

- Mint one [`Assessment`](gmeow-Assessment.md) per criterion (a 21-axis pass is 21 Assessments), naming the target with [`gmeow:assessmentTarget`](../properties/gmeow-assessmentTarget.md), the criterion/rubric with [`gmeow:assessmentCriterion`](../properties/gmeow-assessmentCriterion.md) / [`gmeow:assessmentRubric`](../properties/gmeow-assessmentRubric.md), the score with [`gmeow:assessmentScoreValue`](../properties/gmeow-assessmentScoreValue.md), and the judge as observation vantage.

### Examples

- ex:as1 a [`gmeow:Assessment`](gmeow-Assessment.md); [`gmeow:assessmentTarget`](../properties/gmeow-assessmentTarget.md) ex:chapter3; [`gmeow:assessmentCriterion`](../properties/gmeow-assessmentCriterion.md) ex:agency; [`gmeow:assessmentScoreValue`](../properties/gmeow-assessmentScoreValue.md) 0.9.
